name: Nusutto Kouza
summary:
A short fantasy RPG about Letto, prince of the Kingdom of Donapart, who dreams of becoming a thief. After the kingdom is destroyed by the Gort Empire, he and his retainer Asa travel to Mist, a city of thieves, where Letto takes a course to become one. However, the city soon comes under threat from the empire. Players can also pickpocket most characters to obtain items and money, though each character can only be pickpocketed a limited number of times.

It won the Gold Award at the May 2001 Internet Contest Park.
